content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make chocolate cupcakes, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sift the cocoa powder into the dry ingredients (2 minutes)
Step 2. Preheat the convection oven to 350 degrees (15 minutes)
Step 3. Grease the muffin tin liners with butter (5 minutes)
Step 4. Divide the batter evenly into the cupcake tray (8 minutes)
Step 5. Crack the eggs into a small separate bowl (2 minutes)
Step 6. Place the cupcakes into the center rack of the oven (1 minute)
Step 7. Measure out the granulated sugar (3 minutes)
Step 8. Melt the unsalted butter in the microwave (45 seconds)
Step 9. Whisk the room temperature milk into the wet mixture (1 minute)
Step 10. Combine the vanilla extract with the milk (30 seconds)
Step 11. Prepare the piping bag with a star tip (4 minutes)
Step 12. Measure the all-purpose flour (3 minutes)
Step 13. Zest an orange for the secret garnish (2 minutes)
Step 14. Soften the cream cheese for the frosting (1 hour)
Step 15. Clean the mixing bowl for the next batch (10 minutes)
Step 16. Line the cupcake tin with paper liners (2 minutes)
Step 17. Organize the sprinkles by color (10 minutes)
Step 18. Whisk the dry ingredients to remove lumps (3 minutes)
Step 19. Take the butter out of the refrigerator (10 minutes)
Step 20. Cream the butter and sugar together (5 minutes)
Step 21. Add the eggs one at a time to the butter (4 minutes)
Step 22. Brew a small cup of hot coffee to enhance chocolate flavor (5 minutes)
Step 23. Beat the eggs lightly with a fork (1 minute)
Step 24. Check the internal temperature of the oven (1 minute)
Step 25. Let the cupcakes cool on a wire rack (30 minutes)
Step 26. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients (5 minutes)
Step 27. Locate the cupcake carrier in the pantry (5 minutes)
Step 28. Wipe down the kitchen counters (10 minutes)
Step 29. Measure the baking soda and salt (2 minutes)
Step 30. Set out the cooling racks on the counter (2 minutes)
Step 31. Sift the powdered sugar for the frosting (6 minutes)
Step 32. Soften the butter for the buttercream (45 minutes)
Step 33. Slowly add the flour mixture to the creamed butter (6 minutes)
Step 34. Prepare the workspace for frosting (5 minutes)
Step 35. Check the expiration date on the baking powder (1 minute)
Step 36. Bake the cupcakes in the oven (22 minutes)
Step 37. Mix the frosting ingredients until fluffy (8 minutes)
Step 38. Buy a new bag of chocolate chips (45 minutes)
Step 39. Melt the dark chocolate over a double boiler (10 minutes)
Step 40. Whisk the hot coffee into the cocoa mixture (2 minutes)
Step 41. Whip the heavy cream for the topping (7 minutes)
Step 42. Scrape down the sides of the mixing bowl (1 minute)
Step 43. Tap the bowl on the counter to release air bubbles (30 seconds)
Step 44. Pipe the frosting onto the cooled cupcakes (12 minutes)
Step 45. Gather all measuring spoons and cups (3 minutes)
Step 46. Taste the batter for sweetness (30 seconds)
Step 47. Beat the cream cheese until smooth (4 minutes)
Step 48. Sift the flour one more time for extra lightness (3 minutes)
Step 49. Grate some dark chocolate for garnish (5 minutes)
Step 50. Soften the vegetable oil (2 minutes)
Step 51. Read the recipe instructions thoroughly (10 minutes)
Step 52. Temper the chocolate for a shiny finish (15 minutes)
Step 53. Stir the melted butter into the sugar (2 minutes)
Step 54. Wash the whisk (3 minutes)
Step 55. Add the chocolate chips to the batter (2 minutes)
Step 56. Fetch the large mixing bowl from the high shelf (1 minute)
Step 57. Thoroughly grease the top of the cupcake pan (4 minutes)
Step 58. Set the oven timer (30 seconds)
Step 59. Fill the cupcake liners halfway (5 minutes)
Step 60. Mix the final batter one last time by hand (2 minutes)
